ThingDef.label: Great Rift
ThingDef.description: A hole torn in the world, wide enough to walk through. Demons pour out of it in waves, and the ground around it rots. It will burn itself out in three days and leave a crater of corruption.\n\nKill its rift keeper, or perform a cleansing rite beside it, and it closes now, with far less damage.

IncidentDef.label: Great Rift
IncidentDef.letterText: A Great Rift has torn open near the colony. Demon waves will pour out of it every 18 hours for three days, and the ground around it is rotting.\n\nIts rift keeper stands guard beside it. Kill the keeper, or perform a cleansing rite within reach, and the rift closes now. Leave it, and it burns out into a crater of corruption.
